title: Yellowmoon gain regimes (docs/06-noise.md, section Priors, Gain regimes)
description: data/cameras/noise/gain-regimes.json: where each body switches conversion gain, its base ISO and the ISO above which the raw looks processed. Hand-maintained; data from public_priors.py overrides it.

switch_iso.description: The high-gain regime starts at this ISO; null = no break.

base_iso.description: ISOs below this use the gain of this ISO; null = 100.

processed_hi_iso_above.description: ISOs above this look processed (prior widened); null = not known.

source.description: Where the row comes from; every row of the V1 table says 'docs/06 table, to be confirmed on samples'.
